title: TraCT: Disaggregated LLM Serving with CXL Shared Memory KV Cache at Rack-Scale
authors: Dongha Yoon; Younghoon Min; Hoshik Kim; Sam H. Noh; Jongryool Kim

problem_statement.en: Disaggregated LLM serving architectures suffer from high latency and throughput bottlenecks caused by network-based (RDMA) transfer of KV tensors between prefill and decode workers.
problem_statement.zh: 解耦合 LLM 服務架構因 prefill 與 decode worker 之間透過網路（RDMA）傳輸 KV tensor，而面臨高 latency 與 throughput 瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: TraCT, a rack-scale system that uses CXL shared memory as a network-free KV-transfer substrate and prefix-aware KV cache, enabling direct GPU-to-CXL DMA.
key_innovation.zh: TraCT 是一個機架規模系統，以 CXL 共享記憶體作為無需網路的 KV 傳輸基底，並結合前綴感知 KV cache，實現 GPU 至 CXL 的直接 DMA。

key_improvements.en: 9.8x average TTFT reduction, 6.2x P99 latency reduction, 1.6x peak throughput increase
key_improvements.zh: 平均 TTFT 降低 9.8x，P99 latency 降低 6.2x，峰值 throughput 提升 1.6x。

workload_and_traffic.ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding, KV Cache

hardware_infrastructure.compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A6000, Niagara 2.0 CXL Type-3 memory expander
